title: cozy retreat in Green Hills
description:
Your relaxing oasis in Green Hills, Nashville's uber upscale neighborhood. Super safe. Nearby to Bluebird Cafe, world-class shopping and casual-to -ancy restaurants. Your side of duplex includes beautiful sun room, living room/kitchen combo, bedroom and bath. Beautiful backyard with multiple seating and dining areas. 10 minutes from Vanderbilt, Belmont and Lipscomb universities. You never know which music stars you will see in the local Whole Foods? Private spacious parking area.

The space
We have a futon that folds out into a queen size bed with linens in the closet if you need a bed in addition to the king size bed in the bedroom.
